title: SFX -- world star-gutter (a light dies, anchor)
_note: A star goes out / a light is snuffed - the DARK counterpart to the triumphant rising 'world-gleam' sparkle. Hollow, descending, GUTTERING: a round hollow pulse50 tone falls in a long down-glide (the star dropping out of the sky), guttering as it goes - a faltering detuned pulse12 that wavers down a fraction and dies, plus a low noise 'whump' wash sinking under it (the hollow dark closing in). Down = a thing lost; unresolved, no bright bell. ~0.5s. Render --tail 0.18 for a hollow fade.
